universities.name: Tagore Engineering College
universities.summary: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is a private, self-financing engineering college founded in 1998 at Rathinamangalam, Vandalur, on the southern edge of Chennai in Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu. It is not a university: it is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees. It teaches seven AICTE-approved B.E./B.Tech branches and an MBA in English.
universities.campusLifestyle: Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s campus on the Vandalur-Kelambakkam Road has four academic blocks, department laboratories including an aeronautical hangar with aero engines, a machine shop, a computer centre, a library, an auditorium, a 150-seat air-conditioned mini auditorium (Bharathiar Hall) and an open-air auditorium. Its 2026-27 disclosure lists indoor games, a gym, outdoor courts and grounds for ten sports, a cafeteria, a bank and lifts and ground-floor classrooms for students with disabilities. The cultural festival is called YASHAS.
universities.cityProfile: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is at Rathinamangalam on the Vandalur-Kelambakkam Main Road, Chennai 600127, in Vandalur taluk of Chengalpattu district, Tamil Nadu (AICTE's records still show the former Kanchipuram district). DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet places it 40 km from the district headquarters and 7 km from Vandalur railway station. Anna University lists it among Chengalpattu district colleges with examination code 4127. The college is run by the Tagore Educational Trust, Chennai; Tagore Medical and Dental colleges are separate institutions not covered here.
universities.practicalExposure: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is not autonomous, so it follows Anna University's curricula and regulations: the university sets the syllabus, conducts the end-semester exams and awards the degree, and the college runs internal assessment. AICTE makes an internship mandatory for every admitted student. The training and placement cell runs aptitude, personality and technical training. In TEC's NIRF 2026 engineering data, 158 of 160 B.E./B.Tech students graduating in 2024-25 were placed at a median salary of INR 4,00,000, and its management data show 47 of 53 MBA graduates placed at a median of INR 4,00,000. NBA accredits CSE, ECE, IT and the MBA to 30 June 2027.
universities.hostelOverview: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) has permanent on-campus hostels for men and women, with furnished shared rooms and a campus clinic staffed by an MBBS doctor and a nurse. Its 2026-27 AICTE disclosure estimates boarding and lodging at INR 85,000 a year, and the Tamil Nadu MBA/MCA 2026-27 booklet lists room rent of INR 37,000, electricity of INR 11,000 and mess charges of INR 47,000 a year; confirm the current charge with the college.
universities.dietarySupport: Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s hostel messes serve both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food for men and women, according to DoTE's TNEA 2026 college booklet. The MBA/MCA 2026-27 booklet lists the mess charge at INR 47,000 a year. TEC publishes no menu and no provision for specific regional or religious diets, so ask the hostel office before joining.
universities.safetyOverview: Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s anti-ragging committee, chaired by the principal, includes the Thazhambur police inspector, the Vandalur revenue inspector, parent and student representatives and both hostel wardens, and covers the campus, bus stops and college buses. An internal complaints committee handles sexual-harassment complaints and reports to Anna University's POSH cell. TNEA 2026 publishes an anti-ragging phone number for the college.
universities.studentSupport: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) handles complaints through a grievance redressal committee: students first raise an issue with the head of department, who must respond within 7 working days, and can then take it to the committee. An SC/ST committee guides students to scholarships, slow learners get teacher guardians and remedial classes, and sports-quota entrants get fee concessions. Contact: principal@tagore-engg.ac.in or 044 2229 9400.

faq.question: Is Tagore Engineering College autonomous or affiliated to Anna University?
faq.answer: Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is a non-autonomous college affiliated to Anna University, Chennai, which sets its syllabus and exams and awards its degrees. Anna University lists it in Chengalpattu district with examination code 4127, and DoTE's TNEA 2026 booklet gives its autonomous status as No.

faq.question: What is the TNEA code for Tagore Engineering College?
faq.answer: The TNEA counselling code for Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is 1420. In TNEA 2026 TEC offered AI and Data Science (AD), Aeronautical (AE), CSE (CS), CSE Cyber Security (SC), ECE (EC), IT (IT) and Mechanical (ME). The same code 1420 is used in Tamil Nadu's MBA/MCA counselling.

faq.question: Is Tagore Engineering College AICTE approved?
faq.answer: Yes, Tagore Engineering College (TEC) is AICTE approved as a private self-financing institution, permanent ID 1-9722913. Its latest published Extension of Approval, for 2025-26 (3 January 2025), covers seven B.E./B.Tech branches, the MBA and two M.E. programmes, all affiliated to Anna University.

faq.question: What is the fee at Tagore Engineering College?
faq.answer: Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s 2026-27 AICTE disclosure lists 2025-26 tuition of INR 50,000 a year for TNEA government-quota B.E./B.Tech seats, or INR 55,000 on NBA-accredited CSE, ECE and IT. Management-quota tuition is INR 85,000, or INR 87,000 on accredited branches. The MBA costs INR 35,000 (government quota) or INR 41,000 a year.

faq.question: Is Tagore Engineering College NBA accredited?
faq.answer: Yes, for four programmes: NBA accredits Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering, B.Tech Information Technology and MBA for academic years 2024-25 to 2026-27, valid to 30 June 2027. Aeronautical, Mechanical, AI and Data Science and Cyber Security are not accredited.

faq.question: Does Tagore Engineering College admit international or NRI students?
faq.answer: No, Tagore Engineering College (TEC) has no NRI or foreign-national seats: AICTE's 2024-25 and 2025-26 approvals mark NRI and FN/Gulf/OCI approval as No for every course. TNEA is for Indian nationals; OCI/PIO card holders who are natives of Tamil Nadu may apply unless born abroad after 4 March 2021.

faq.question: How do I get admission to Tagore Engineering College?
faq.answer: Most B.E./B.Tech seats at Tagore Engineering College (TEC) are filled through TNEA: register at tneaonline.org, get a rank from Mathematics (100), Physics (50) and Chemistry (50), and choose code 1420. TNEA 2026 counselling ran 20 July to 30 August, and Anna University starts first-semester classes on 2 September 2026. Management-quota seats are filled by the college.

faq.question: What are the placements like at Tagore Engineering College?
faq.answer: In Tagore Engineering College (TEC)'s NIRF 2026 data, 158 of the 160 B.E./B.Tech students who graduated in 2024-25 were placed, at a median salary of INR 4,00,000. In the management data, 47 of 53 MBA graduates of 2024-25 were placed at a median of INR 4,00,000.

faq.question: Does Tagore Engineering College have hostels?
faq.answer: Yes, Tagore Engineering College (TEC) has permanent on-campus hostels for men and women with messes serving vegetarian and non-vegetarian food. Its 2026-27 disclosure estimates boarding and lodging at INR 85,000 a year.
